<?php
$n = intval(fgets(STDIN));
$step = 0;
$cheak = false;
if ($n >= 1 && $n <= pow(10, 9)) {
    if ($n == 1) {
        echo $n . "\n";
    } elseif ($n == 2) {
        echo 1 . "\n";
    } elseif ($n == 5) {
        echo 3 . "\n";
    } else {
        while ($n != 0 && $n != 5) {
            if ($cheak == false) {
                if ($n != 0) {
                    $n--;
                    $step++;
                    $cheak = true;
                }
            }
            if ($cheak == true) {
                if ($n != 0) {
                    $n -= 2;
                    $step++;
                    $cheak = false;
                }
            }
            if ($n == 1) {
                $step++;
                break;
            } elseif ($n == 2) {
                $step++;
                break;
            } elseif ($n == 5) {
                $step += 3;
                break;
            }
        }
        echo $step . "\n";
    }
}
